senses.gloss:
√ṛt 'pursue'
aorist: [5.] artiḍhvam 
future: artiṣye 
derivatives: artaná -artitṛ V1. ártuka ŚB1. 
A very doubtful root; ánvartiṣye and anvartitṛ́ apparent contractions for anu-vart-; and Bö. amends artiḍhvam to arthi- (but??). But arana and artuka seem to show that the thing had assumed the value of a root.
